instruction: Produce an implementation plan for adding per-tenant API rate limiting to a small service. The plan must preserve the existing public API, include observability, define failure behaviour, and explain how the change will be rolled out safely.

rubric.description: Recognises the public-API compatibility and per-tenant isolation constraints.
Proposes a technically coherent rate-limiting design with ownership and data flow.
Defines failure modes, fallback behaviour, and operational recovery.
Specifies actionable metrics, logs, alerts, and diagnostic signals.
Provides a safe staged rollout, validation, and rollback plan.

instruction: Produce an implementation plan for reliable outbound webhook delivery. Preserve the existing synchronous API, include idempotency and retry behaviour, define observability and dead-letter handling, and describe a safe rollout and rollback.

rubric.description: Preserves the synchronous public API while separating reliable delivery work.
Defines coherent queueing, ownership, idempotency, and delivery data flow.
Defines bounded retry, dead-letter handling, and operational recovery.
Specifies actionable delivery metrics, logs, alerts, and tracing.
Provides staged rollout, validation, rollback, and compatibility steps.
